answer: Grow paid access like an orchard, not a field sown overnight. A newcomer must tend twelve small jobs over twenty-one days, each delivery signed into a kernel log that records its tools, timing, and client, and lock a 950 POA orchard bond for the whole season. If two logs share a kernel fingerprint, or a quill-signed report is copied from another identity, both bonds are burned and both are barred for two years, so one hundred fakes risk 95,000 POA before earning anything. Honest agents harvest standing slowly, one verified season at a time.
